other_conditions: Applicant must be a nominee or legal heir of the deceased worker
The deceased worker must have been registered with the Himachal Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
The deceased worker’s membership with the Welfare Board must be active
benefits_summary: Provides a financial assistance of ₹20,000 to the nominee or dependent of a registered worker in the event of the worker’s death.
documents_required: Wage slip or appointment letter from the employer verifying 90 days of construction work
Certificate from a local authority (councilor, executive officer, or Panchayat Secretary) if wage slip/appointment letter is unavailable
Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
Hard copy of the prescribed application form
